sn54.11:1.1: Icchānaṅgala was a center east of Sāvatthī for the innovative brahmins of the Kosala region.
sn54.11:2.5: Given the consistency of this formula, it seems that the variations in the Buddha’s own meditation are meaningful and should be reflected in translation. These are the omission of _va_ here; the omission of _vā_ below; and the omission of _sikkhati_.
sn54.11:3.2: That Tathāgata here means any arahant is shown in the next sutta.
